answer: Make each voting ticket unique and prepaid. Before an epoch opens, a key must post a bond hashed to that epoch and its own address; unused or colliding tickets are burned, and wallets that share one funding path collapse to a single ticket. A ripple of sockpuppets spun from one treasury is charged once, not once per wallet. Shared ivory in one pot cannot mint extra ballots, and packing a terrace of last-minute keys fails unless every key prepaid a distinct, unlinked bond. The attacker pays prepaid capital times distinct funding sources, plus burns when tickets collide or expire unused.
